_comment_instances: Leave instances empty in production. Add databases from the console (Admin → Databases); they persist in buho.monitor_targets inside the store volume. Optional file-based instances remain supported for labs. For app probes use engine endpoint + endpoint.url / dependsOnAlias. For PRTG-class Hosts use engine infra + infra.sensors[] (see lab/infra/config.infra.lab.json). Deep Platform: engine kafka|cdc|airflow — see DEEP_PLATFORM.md.
_comment_mssql_lab_password: Match docker-compose.mssql-lab.yml: set MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD in the shell or use the default above; do not commit real passwords.
_comment_oracle_lab: docker compose -f docker-compose.oracle-lab.yml up -d — first start can take several minutes.
